class: scope narrower than the warrant it argues from

expect.why: the Scope names the three fallen statuses and the Warrant argues from a terminal status; non-comparable is terminal without being a fall, so the two sentences state rules over two different populations and a reader implements whichever one they read
expect.message: the Scope names the fallen statuses

expect.why: the checker cannot say which of the two the author meant; widening the Scope and narrowing the Warrant are both legal repairs, and only the author knows which claim was made

note: K25 is the near-negative: the same entry with a Warrant that names the fallen three rather than terminality, which every checker must leave alone. The pair is what keeps the rule from being satisfied by a checker that flags every entry naming a status.
